newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to hold briefing on DKB, Nomura JGB business.
newsitem.headline: MOF to hold briefing on DKB, Nomura JGB business.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will hold a briefing on participation by Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd in Japanese government bond (JGB) auctions and underwriting on Wednesday evening, a MOF spokesman said.
He said the briefing would follow news conferences by chiefs of the banking and securities bureaus.

MOF said earlier that Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka would announce penalties against Nomura and DKB at 5 p.m. (0800 GMT), and that this would be followed by news conferences by the banking and securities bureau chiefs.
